capabilities: Render a flame-shaped glow that follows the caret
Dim text outside the torch's light reach
Replace the caret with a glowing gradient bar
Flicker the glow like a real flame
Configure glow size, color, intensity, darkness and reach
disambiguation: Not a theme or CSS snippet; it is a caret-centered lighting effect that works alongside any theme.
extras: The plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Reduces flicker automatically when the OS requests reduced motion; recommends dark themes.
problem: Obsidian's editor has a plain caret with no ambient visual feedback or focused-light writing mode.
summary: Editor visual effect that turns the text caret into a flickering torch glow while the rest of the note fades into darkness.
